name: world-wilde-web
description: A sourced map of documented queer relationships, 1870s-1940s, beginning with Oscar Wilde's circle.
comment: There is no JavaScript toolchain here and no dependencies to install - the site is plain HTML, CSS, JS and JSON. These scripts only wrap tools/*.py so `npm start` works if that is the habit; `python tools/serve.py` does exactly the same thing. Python 3.8+ is the only requirement.
